# Introduction

This document includes supplementary data and computational details related to the paper "Krill oil supplementation with and without resistance training lowers the burden of the metabolic syndrome but does not affect glucose tolerance in sedentary adults: a randomized controlled trial". 


## Project organisation

This notebook is built from source code available at the github repository [trainome/alpha-omega-trial](https://github.com/trainome/alpha-omega-trial/). The data used in analyses is organized as an R data package available in a separate repository [trainome/AOData](https://github.com/trainome/AOData/).    

### R scripts

- `R/fig-opt-fun.R` - Helper functions and settings for data visualisations.
- `R/helpers.R` - Helper functions for modelling.
- `R/packages.R` - Loading required packages.
- `R/data-prep.R` - Prepares data for the Metabolic syndrome analysis.
- `R/sim-fun.R` - Functions related to simulation studies. 


### Stan models

All Stan model scripts are stored in `/models/`. If model code is executed locally, model executable are also stored here. Model fits are stored in `fits/` but not pushed to github due to their large size.
